data.title: Parking warning fee of €30
data.summary: Stadt Musterstadt's regulatory office (Ordnungsamt) issued a warning with a €30.00 fine (Verwarnungsgeld) for parking without a valid ticket on 12 September 2026. It must be paid within one week of receiving the letter.
data.explanation: The city says you were named as the driver of a car-sharing vehicle that was parked without a valid ticket. The warning only takes effect if you agree and pay €30.00 within one week of receiving the letter, to the account given. If you disagree or want to comment, use the enclosed hearing form (Anhörungsbogen). If you don't pay on time, a fine proceeding (Bußgeldverfahren) starts, with extra fees and costs of at least €28.50. Quote the reference number (Kassenzeichen) in the payment.
